description: Caption schema for ship themes (sampling the theme's representative ship art). Output by Gemini using Tools/captioning/prompts/theme_prompt.md.

field_descriptions.materials_and_finish: Apparent materials, surface treatment, weathering, panel detail.
field_descriptions.design_philosophy: What the engineering choices imply (speed, durability, elegance, intimidation, mass production).
field_descriptions.color_scheme: Palette and accent placement across the hull.
field_descriptions.technology_level_hint: Implied tech level from visible engineering (welds, plates, exotic materials).
field_descriptions.distinctive_traits: Anything unusual or memorable — recognizable silhouettes, signature features.
